title: Titanic Chapter10 who survived—22 exactly named historical source-first visual beats
source_narration: Keep all original 11 Kokoro paragraphs T10_P01 to P11 unmodified; A/B timing from measured shot ledger

shots.onscreen_label: THE REAL 1912 NEWS · EARLY TOTALS WERE UNCERTAIN
shots.editorial_why: Period April 1912 news front page, photographed later, establishes reporting uncertainty; its numbers are explicitly not claimed to be the final British count.

shots.onscreen_label: BRITISH REPORT: 2,201 ABOARD · 711 SAVED
shots.editorial_why: Source-labelled official final British totals compared without mixing Senate definitions; diagrams are necessary to display statistics honestly.

shots.onscreen_label: FIRST CLASS ON TITANIC · GENUINE 10 APRIL MENU
shots.editorial_why: A surviving authentic first-class menu demonstrates onboard social divisions but is not presented as proof of first-class survival rate.

shots.onscreen_label: ABOUT 62% / 41% / 25% BY PASSENGER CLASS
shots.editorial_why: British report sourced class percentages need a direct accurate data chart and are not inferred from photographs.

shots.onscreen_label: REAL TITANIC SURVIVOR CHILDREN · AFTER RESCUE
shots.editorial_why: Actual contemporary survivor child portrait establishes human identities; does not purport to prove group-wide gender/age percentages.

shots.onscreen_label: SEX AND AGE ALSO AFFECTED SURVIVAL
shots.editorial_why: British report figures depend on age and sex; schematic separates correlated categories without claiming identical groups.

shots.onscreen_label: THIRD CLASS ONBOARD LIFE · ACTUAL 1912 MENU
shots.editorial_why: True period third-class document demonstrates differentiated accommodation, NOT a locked gate or systematic exclusion order.

shots.onscreen_label: BRITISH INQUIRY REJECTED SYSTEMATIC EXCLUSION
shots.editorial_why: Evidence-versus-interpretation graphic distinguishes absence of officially found deliberate gate discrimination from structural disadvantage.

shots.onscreen_label: WHERE THE BRITISH WRECK INQUIRY MET · 1912
shots.editorial_why: Exact historic London hearing venue directly illustrates the institution that evaluated third-class testimony; not a staged passenger account.

shots.onscreen_label: THE U.S. SENATE ALSO HEARD TITANIC WITNESSES
shots.editorial_why: Separate genuine U.S. Senate investigation photograph places two inquiries side-by-side as different institutions with different totals.

shots.onscreen_label: A GENUINE 1912 RESCUE-ARRIVAL IMMIGRATION RECORD
shots.editorial_why: Contemporary Carpathia immigrant/survivor manifest evidences migration and named travellers, not the hypothetical family's private conversation.

shots.onscreen_label: REAL SURVIVOR FAMILY · PHOTOGRAPHED AFTER DISASTER
shots.editorial_why: Authentic survivor family gives human context, clearly not depicted as the hypothetical example in the narration.

shots.onscreen_label: FIRST-CLASS DINING ROOM · ORIGINAL INTERIOR
shots.editorial_why: Actual photographed first-class setting relevant to onboard differences; not treated as proof of routes to the boat deck.

shots.onscreen_label: ACTUAL TITANIC UPPER BOAT DECK · 11 APR 1912
shots.editorial_why: A real dated boat-deck photograph contrasts upper-deck access with distant cabins; it does not claim the photo shows a first-class passenger walking.

shots.onscreen_label: THE EIGHT TITANIC MUSICIANS · PERIOD PHOTO COLLAGE
shots.editorial_why: Genuine post-disaster 1912 photographs of ship workers who did not survive, emphasizing crew losses, not an onboard performance photograph.

shots.onscreen_label: 885 CREW · 212 SURVIVED IN BRITISH REPORT
shots.editorial_why: Statistical source chart compares working departments more accurately than guessing actual job categories from images.

shots.onscreen_label: CHARLOTTE COLLYER AND HER DAUGHTER · 1912
shots.editorial_why: Authentic photographed named survivor and child, with genuine sourced identity; private thoughts never invented.

shots.onscreen_label: MORE THAN A NAME IN A REGISTER
shots.editorial_why: Different contemporary survivor family represents actual preserved human evidence rather than fictionalized intimate dialogues.

shots.onscreen_label: SEPARATE CABINS AND PASSAGEWAYS · SCHEMATIC
shots.editorial_why: Titanic physical/societal separation needs labelled original ship-layout illustration; photo alone cannot show its route consequences.

shots.onscreen_label: THE SAME SHIP HELD DIFFERENT PASSENGER EXPERIENCES
shots.editorial_why: Period actual Titanic vessel photograph contextualizes one vessel and the effect of internal social divisions, with date noted.

shots.onscreen_label: ACTUAL BOATS NEAR CARPATHIA AFTER RESCUE
shots.editorial_why: Real 1912 boats photographed following rescue show physical separation from ship; no footage of final sinking is represented.

shots.onscreen_label: THE FINAL MINUTES CANNOT BE FILMED
shots.editorial_why: Explicitly labelled final-stage evidence-versus-reconstruction graphic; no genuine camera recorded Titanic's sinking.

hard_rule: No historic photo presented as proof of gender statistics, hypothetical migrant dialogue, a British inquiry if it depicts US Senate, or specific sinking actions.
media_sourcing: Reuse exact hashed sources in original 17-image archive, 18 source-specific candidate pack and previous Chapter09; fetch only three expressly chosen missing 1912 records.
